subject.title: fix: ClawHub search passes unbounded limit to the API

question: Should `openclaw skills search --limit` retain its current ability to request more than 100 results, or gain a new explicit maximum of 100?
rationale: The Gateway RPC already has a maximum, but the independently exposed direct CLI accepts larger positive integers and ClawHub serves them; choosing to narrow that user-facing contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve larger CLI limits
options.body: Keep the direct CLI contract unchanged and leave the existing maximum at the Gateway entry point only.

options.title: Add an explicit CLI maximum
options.body: Reject values above 100 at CLI parsing with documentation and live compatibility proof rather than silently truncating them downstream.

recommendation.title: Preserve larger CLI limits
recommendation.body: Keep the direct CLI contract unchanged and leave the existing maximum at the Gateway entry point only.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history across the native ClawHub lifecycle, direct CLI, and recent shared-path refactor points to this owner for the contract decision.
